title: Approved request bodies from stdin (`json-stdin`)
description: The approved snapshot models a body policy of none or json-stdin (spec 9.2: "P0 may permit an approved profile to accept a bounded non-secret JSON request body from stdin"), and WCLI-9 normalized both values. WCLI-10 implements only `none`: `ward run` refuses an approved json-stdin profile with run_body_unsupported rather than sending the request without the body the endpoint expects. This task implements it or records why it is declined. Spec 9.2 is explicit that the permission must be visible during approval and that an endpoint permitting arbitrary bodies must not be described as fine-grained business-action authorization, so the approval prompt is part of the work, not an implementation detail.

acceptanceCriteria.text: An approved json-stdin profile sends a body Ward read from stdin, bounded in size, and the bytes reach the wire only as the approved request body
The body is never a secret path: it is not written to the vault, an audit record, an error message or any output, and T09-class non-disclosure evidence covers it
The approval prompt states the body permission visibly, and the profile is not described anywhere as fine-grained business-action authorization
A body over the bound, or one that is not the declared shape, is refused before anything is sent
